_comment: Template for runtime/providers.json (gitignored). Copy it, pick a default profile, and put the KEY IN THE ENVIRONMENT — api_key inline is refused. The key may also live in ~/.config/cyboros/<profile>.env (mode 600, KEY=value or export KEY=value); the environment wins. Cloud profiles need allow_cloud=true here and --allow-cloud on the run, which also connects at launch. type is openai-compatible for v1 (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio).
